# Industry

This part asks how the work meets the conventions of regulated drug
development. It belongs to the second quarter and is a branch rather
than a step: the capstone draws on it but does not require it, and
a reader headed for academic research may postpone it.
Pharmaceutical-track students should treat both chapters as core.

- @sec-cdisc traces a trial's data from the case report form through
  SDTM and ADaM to the tables of a clinical study report, and
  derives two ADaM datasets in R.
- @sec-sas teaches enough SAS to read a program and its log, write
  the R equivalent, and predict where the two fits of one model
  will disagree.

If the quiz at the start of a chapter is easy, skip to the next.
